definitions.gloss: to sneer at; to ridicule; to mock
definitions.explanation: To laugh at someone or something with contempt or scorn. Stronger and more hostile than simply laughing at someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}った。
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}うべきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't mock other people's efforts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}われて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Even though those around her ridiculed her, she did not give up on her dream.

notes:
{嘲笑|あざわら}う is a transitive godan verb. It carries a strongly negative nuance — contemptuous or scornful laughter directed at someone.

ASPECT (ている):
{嘲笑|あざわら}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing act of mocking someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to mock someone/something)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}われる (to be ridiculed by someone — passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to mock a person)
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲笑|あざわら}う (to sneer at a failure)
- {嘲笑|あざわら}うような⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (a mocking attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ is neutral laughter, ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is general making fun of. {嘲笑|あざわら}う is specifically contemptuous, scornful laughter — stronger and more literary than either.
